audience: marketing and operations teams that generate images and PDFs from DynaPictures templates

useCases.title: Find a template and its layer names
useCases.text: List the templates with their layer names. Read one template to see its layers, sizes and text.

useCases.title: Generate an image from a template
useCases.text: Render a template with your data and return the image URL. Each image or PDF page uses one image credit.

useCases.title: Build an image link without a credit
useCases.text: Build a public image URL for a template with layer overrides. No API call is made and no credit is used.

useCases.title: Search the images generated this month
useCases.text: Find generated images by keyword, metadata text or a start and end date, up to 200 per call.

useCases.title: Add an image to the media library
useCases.text: Upload an image from a public URL to a workspace media library. Then use its URL in template layers.
